name: Wedding-Bouquet
logline_subject_info: The elegant wedding bouquet held by the Bride, which she later throws to the floor.
visual_desc: A close-up shot of a luxurious and elegant wedding bouquet. It is a tightly packed, round arrangement composed primarily of large, flawless white peonies and cream-colored roses, with subtle accents of silver-dollar eucalyptus leaves and baby's breath. The stems are wrapped in a wide, white satin ribbon, tied in a simple, elegant knot. The flowers are fresh and pristine. The object is displayed against a blank, solid deep-charcoal background with soft studio lighting.
video_visual_desc: An elegant wedding bouquet of white peonies and cream roses, with stems wrapped in white satin ribbon.
